_key_races_help: Race titles (e.g. 'MO House 96', 'Amendment 6', 'MO US House 2') or national race_ids (e.g. '2026-SEN-NC'). National races can also be flagged with key_race=TRUE in the calls sheet.

polls._help: Pre-election polls for national Senate/Governor races. Chain: RCP -> Silver Bulletin -> Politico -> 270toWin (first that is reachable and has a parser).

social._help: Public X lists shown in the 'Live chatter' panel via X's official embed (widgets.js). No API tokens.

_baselines_help: Seats NOT up per chamber. National chambers count national races; entries with scope 'mo' (mo_senate, mo_house) count the MO cards. 'super' = two-thirds line. In 2028 the odd Senate districts are up, so mo_senate holdovers become the even districts.
